# archestra_auto_router (Data Source)

ALPHA. Looks up an auto router by the model name clients request (`auto` or `auto:<name>`), for example to reference a router created in the UI. Requires API 1.5.0-rc.29 or later with `ARCHESTRA_AUTO_ROUTING_ENABLED=true` (or `ARCHESTRA_BETA=true`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# ALPHA. Look up a router created in the UI by the model name clients request.
data "archestra_auto_router" "default" {
  name = "auto"
}

# Make it the organization default for agents without their own model.
resource "archestra_organization_settings" "this" {
  default_auto_router_id = data.archestra_auto_router.default.id
}

output "auto_router_tiers" {
  value = data.archestra_auto_router.default.tiers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Router model name: `auto` or `auto:<name>`.

### Read-Only

- `budget_preset` (String) Budget preset, if any.
- `budget_usd_per_day` (Number) Custom daily budget in USD, if any.
- `decision_model` (Attributes) Model that scores sessions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--decision_model))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the router currently routes sessions.
- `id` (String) Auto router UUID.
- `tiers` (Attributes) The router's fast, normal and smart tiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))
- `virtual_api_key_ids` (Set of String) Virtual keys granted this router.

<a id="nestedatt--decision_model"></a>
### Nested Schema for `decision_model`

Read-Only:

- `api_key_id` (String) Provider key for the decision model; null uses the organization's primary decisions key.
- `model` (String) Provider-facing model name of the decision model.


<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Read-Only:

- `fast` (Attributes) The fast tier; null when its model or key was deleted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--fast))
- `normal` (Attributes) The normal tier; null when its model or key was deleted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--normal))
- `smart` (Attributes) The smart tier; null when its model or key was deleted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers--smart))

<a id="nestedatt--tiers--fast"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers.fast`

Read-Only:

- `model_id` (String) Database UUID of the tier's model row.
- `provider_api_key_id` (String) Provider key UUID that serves the tier.

### Nested Schema for `tiers.normal`

- `provider_api_key_id` (String) Provider key UUID that serves the tier.
